examples.chinese: 我男朋友不太喜歡說話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nán péngyǒu bú tài xǐhuān shuōhuà.
examples.english: My boyfriend does not like to talk very much.

examples.chinese: 他說話很有趣，所以每個人都喜歡跟他聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn yǒuqù, suǒyǐ měi ge rén dōu xǐhuan gēn tā liáotiān.
examples.english: He speaks interestingly, so everyone likes to chat with him.

examples.chinese: 考試開始以後，我們不可以跟同學說話。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì kāishǐ yǐhòu, wǒmen bù kěyǐ gēn tóngxué shuōhuà.
examples.english: After the exam starts, we cannot talk with classmates.

examples.chinese: 小藍什麼都不怕，就是怕跟女生說話，只要一說話，他的臉就紅了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán shénme dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà gēn nǚshēng shuōhuà, zhǐyào yì shuōhuà, tā de liǎn jiù hóng le.
examples.english: Xiaolan is not afraid of anything; he is exactly afraid of talking to girls. As soon as he talks, his face turns red.

examples.chinese: 對不起！我昨天跟你說話的態度不好，我向你道歉，請你別生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ zuótiān gēn nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù bù hǎo, wǒ xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn, qǐng nǐ bié shēngqì le.
examples.english: I'm sorry! My attitude when talking to you yesterday was not good. I apologize to you; please don't be angry anymore.

examples.chinese: 就我對小林的了解，他是一個很實在的人，不但做事認真，說話也不誇張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù wǒ duì Xiǎo Lín de liǎojiě, tā shì yīgè hěn shízài de rén, bùdàn zuòshì rènzhēn, shuōhuà yě bù kuāzhāng.
examples.english: With regard to my understanding of Xiao Lin, he is a very honest person; not only does he work seriously, but he also doesn't exaggerate when he speaks.

examples.chinese: 張先生的個性很活潑、說話很幽默，跟他聊天總是很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn huópō, shuōhuà hěn yōumò, gēn tā liáotiān zǒngshì hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's personality is very lively and his speech is very humorous; chatting with him is always very pleasant.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 他最近對你說話的態度變得冷淡，你們之間是不是有什麼誤會？
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn duì nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù biàn de lěngdàn, nǐmen zhījiān shì bùshì yǒu shénme wùhuì?
examples.english: His attitude when speaking to you has recently become cold; is there some misunderstanding between you two?

examples.chinese: 我昨天跟朋友說了很多話，我們都很開心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gēn péngyou shuō le hěn duō huà, wǒmen dōu hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Yesterday I said a lot to my friend, and we were both very happy.

examples.chinese: 經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo. Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english: The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well. Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 李先生經常咳嗽，可是他完全不在意。直到今天咳得說不出話來了，才肯去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng jīngcháng késòu, kěshì tā wánquán bù zàiyì. Zhídào jīntiān ké de shuō bù chū huà lái le, cái kěn qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: Mr. Li often coughs, but he doesn't care at all. It was not until today, when he coughed so much that he couldn't speak, that he was willing to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier.

examples.chinese: 小簡今天遇到以前的女朋友，跟她喝了咖啡才回家，但不敢跟太太說實話。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn jīntiān yùdào yǐqián de nǚpéngyǒu, gēn tā hē le kāfēi cái huí jiā, dàn bù gǎn gēn tàitai shuō shíhuà.
examples.english: Today Xiao Jian ran into his ex-girlfriend, and only went home after having coffee with her, but he didn't dare tell his wife the truth.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 媽媽：鹽用完了，幫我去便利商店買一包吧！孩子：好，我立刻去！
examples.pinyin: Māma: Yán yòng wán le, bāng wǒ qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi yī bāo ba! Háizi: Hǎo, wǒ lìkè qù!
examples.english: Mom: The salt is used up; help me go to the convenience store to buy a pack! Child: Okay, I'll go right away!

examples.chinese: 臺灣人在國外碰到問題時，可以立刻打0800-085-095「你幫我，你救我」這支電話求救。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān rén zài guówài pèngdào wèntí shí, kěyǐ lìkè dǎ 0800-085-095 “nǐ bāng wǒ, nǐ jiù wǒ” zhè zhī diànhuà qiújiù.
examples.english: When Taiwanese people encounter problems abroad, they can immediately call 0800-085-095, the “you help me, you save me” number, to ask for help.

examples.chinese: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 只要打開手機，連上網路，就能立刻掌握全球新聞。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào dǎkāi shǒujī, liánshàng wǎnglù, jiù néng lìkè zhǎngwò quánqiú xīnwén.
examples.english: As long as you turn on your phone and connect to the internet, you can immediately grasp global news.

examples.chinese: 古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiǎojiě zuòshì de tàidù hěn jījí, wèile wánchéng rènwù, zǒngshì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jìhuà, érqiě lìkè shíxíng.
examples.english: Miss Gu has a very proactive attitude toward work. In order to complete tasks, she always makes plans early and immediately carries them out.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn tiēxīn, zhǐyào kèrén yī shàngmén, lìkè tígōng miànzhǐ gěi kèrén cā shǒu.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very considerate; as soon as customers come in, they immediately provide tissues for them to wipe their hands.

examples.chinese: 現代社會資訊很發達，一發生重要事情，立刻就上電視、上報了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì zīxùn hěn fādá, yī fāshēng zhòngyào shìqíng, lìkè jiù shàng diànshì, shàng bào le.
examples.english: In modern society, information is very developed; as soon as an important event happens, it immediately appears on TV and in the newspapers.

examples.chinese: 台灣有句著名的廣告台詞「心動不如馬上行動」，意思是當個人有了想法之後，光是想是沒用的，得立刻行動才行。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu jù zhùmíng de guǎnggào táicí “xīndòng bùrú mǎshàng xíngdòng”, yìsi shì dāng gèrén yǒu le xiǎngfǎ zhīhòu, guāng shì xiǎng shì méiyòng de, děi lìkè xíngdòng cái xíng.
examples.english: Taiwan has a famous advertising slogan, “Acting immediately is better than just being moved.” It means that after a person has an idea, merely thinking about it is useless; one must take action immediately.

examples.chinese: 水災過後應立刻打掃環境，才能降低傳染病流行的機會。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐzāi guòhòu yīng lìkè dǎsǎo huánjìng, cái néng jiàngdī chuánrǎnbìng liúxíng de jīhuì.
examples.english: After a flood, one should immediately clean up the environment; only then can the chance of infectious diseases spreading be reduced.

examples.chinese: 要是病人頭很暈又有發燒症狀時，就必須立刻送醫院檢查。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi bìngrén tóu hěn yūn yòu yǒu fāshāo zhèngzhuàng shí, jiù bìxū lìkè sòng yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
examples.english: If a patient is very dizzy and also has fever symptoms, they must be sent to the hospital for examination immediately.

examples.chinese: 在外國跟在自己國家的生活一定不太一樣。
examples.pinyin: Zài wàiguó gēn zài zìjǐ guójiā de shēnghuó yídìng bú tài yíyàng.
examples.english: Living in a foreign country and living in your own country are definitely not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友這次去英國玩了八天七夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou zhè cì qù Yīngguó wán le bā tiān qī yè.
examples.english: This time I went to England with a friend and played for eight days and seven nights.

examples.chinese: 他跑得很快，如果跟他比賽，我沒有機會贏，一定會輸。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de hěn kuài, rúguǒ gēn tā bǐsài, wǒ méiyǒu jīhuì yíng, yīdìng huì shū.
examples.english: He runs very fast; if I compete with him, I have no chance of winning—I will definitely lose.

examples.chinese: 我記得去年跟幾個朋友一起打過籃球，真好玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde qùnián gēn jǐ gè péngyǒu yīqǐ dǎguo lánqiú, zhēn hǎowán.
examples.english: I remember last year I played basketball with a few friends; it was really fun.

examples.chinese: 他在跟家人談事情，已經講了三十分鐘的話了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gēn jiārén tán shìqíng, yǐjīng jiǎngle sānshí fēnzhōng de huà le.
examples.english: He is discussing something with his family; he has already been talking for thirty minutes.

examples.chinese: 明天我要跟朋友去參加跨年活動，我還沒跟父母講這件事。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào gēn péngyǒu qù cānjiā kuànián huódòng, wǒ hái méi gēn fùmǔ jiǎng zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: Tomorrow I'm going with friends to attend a New Year's Eve event; I still haven't talked to my parents about this.

examples.chinese: 走路跟騎腳踏車的時候，我們都要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zǒulù gēn qí jiǎotàchē de shíhòu, wǒmen dōu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: When walking and riding a bicycle, we all need to be careful.

examples.chinese: 我覺得打球比跑步有意思，我常跟朋友一起打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dǎqiú bǐ pǎobù yǒu yìsi, wǒ cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I think playing ball is more interesting than running; I often play basketball with friends.

examples.chinese: 我每個星期天早上都跟家人去教堂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqītiān zǎoshang dōu gēn jiārén qù jiàotáng.
examples.english: Every Sunday morning I go to church with my family.

examples.chinese: 這個週末有一場演唱會，你要不要跟我一起去看？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò yǒu yī chǎng yǎnchànghuì, nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù kàn?
examples.english: This weekend there is a concert, do you want to go watch it with me?

examples.chinese: 今年你想要跟誰一起跨年？
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián nǐ xiǎng gēn shéi yìqǐ kuànián?
examples.english: Who do you want to celebrate New Year's Eve with this year?

examples.chinese: 下個月有個很大的電腦展，你要跟我去看看嗎？
examples.pinyin: Xià ge yuè yǒu ge hěn dà de diànnǎo zhǎn, nǐ yào gēn wǒ qù kànkan ma?
examples.english: Next month there is a big computer exhibition; do you want to go see it with me?

examples.chinese: 兒子跟女兒都在睡覺，你不要說得太大聲。
examples.pinyin: Érzi gēn nǚ'ér dōu zài shuìjiào, nǐ búyào shuō de tài dàshēng.
examples.english: Both my son and daughter are sleeping; don't speak too loudly.

examples.chinese: 老闆要跟我們談話，想知道我們工作做得怎麼樣。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yào gēn wǒmen tánhuà, xiǎng zhīdào wǒmen gōngzuò zuò de zěnmeyàng.
examples.english: The boss wants to have a conversation with us; he wants to know how our work is going.

examples.chinese: 現在我沒有時間，明天再跟你談這個問題。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān, míngtiān zài gēn nǐ tán zhège wèntí.
examples.english: I don't have time now; I'll talk about this issue with you tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，她常跟朋友一起去跑步。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, tā cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ qù pǎobù.
examples.english: After getting off work, she often goes running with friends.

examples.chinese: 考試開始以後，我們不可以跟同學說話。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì kāishǐ yǐhòu, wǒmen bù kěyǐ gēn tóngxué shuōhuà.
examples.english: After the exam starts, we cannot talk with classmates.

examples.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

examples.chinese: A:你什麼時候有空？要不要跟我去唱歌？ B:我今天下午有空。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shénme shíhou yǒu kòng? Yào bú yào gēn wǒ qù chànggē? B: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu kòng.
examples.english: A: When are you free? Do you want to go sing with me? B: I'm free this afternoon.

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，想給老師打電話，跟他說我不能去上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng gěi lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà, gēn tā shuō wǒ bù néng qù shàngkè.
examples.english: I caught a cold; I want to call the teacher to tell him I can't go to class.

examples.chinese: 他打算坐捷運去跟朋友見面。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn zuò jiéyùn qù gēn péngyǒu jiànmiàn.
examples.english: He plans to take the MRT to meet a friend.

examples.chinese: 你這個週末有空嗎？ 我想跟你見面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège zhōumò yǒu kòng ma? Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn.
examples.english: Are you free this weekend? I want to meet with you.

examples.chinese: 他說話很有趣，所以每個人都喜歡跟他聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn yǒuqù, suǒyǐ měi ge rén dōu xǐhuan gēn tā liáotiān.
examples.english: He speaks interestingly, so everyone likes to chat with him.

examples.chinese: 我昨天跟朋友說了很多話，我們都很開心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gēn péngyou shuō le hěn duō huà, wǒmen dōu hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Yesterday I said a lot to my friend, and we were both very happy.

examples.chinese: 我身體不舒服，所以不能跟你們去打球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēntǐ bù shūfu, suǒyǐ bù néng gēn nǐmen qù dǎ qiú.
examples.english: I am not feeling well, so I cannot go play ball with you.

examples.chinese: 我最愛吃蘋果跟香蕉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì ài chī píngguǒ gēn xiāngjiāo.
examples.english: I love eating apples and bananas the most.

examples.chinese: 他跟我說，他感冒了，要去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ shuō, tā gǎnmào le, yào qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He said to me that he caught a cold and needs to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 我常常跟日本朋友練習說日文。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng gēn Rìběn péngyǒu liànxí shuō Rìwén.
examples.english: I often practice speaking Japanese with Japanese friends.

examples.chinese: 這個禮拜我有很多功課，不能跟你去玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǐbài wǒ yǒu hěn duō gōngkè, bù néng gēn nǐ qù wán.
examples.english: This week I have a lot of homework, so I cannot go out and have fun with you.

examples.chinese: 他最近常常跟朋友一起玩。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn chángcháng gēn péngyǒu yīqǐ wán.
examples.english: He often hangs out with friends recently.

examples.chinese: 我旁邊有日本同學，前面跟後面都有美國同學。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.
examples.english: There are Japanese classmates beside me, and there are American classmates in front and behind.

examples.chinese: 我旁邊有日本同學，前面跟後面都有美國同學。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.
examples.english: There are Japanese classmates beside me, and there are American classmates in front and behind.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽有一個哥哥跟兩個妹妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma yǒu yí ge gēge gēn liǎng ge mèimei.
examples.english: My mom has an elder brother and two younger sisters.

examples.chinese: 我要買一張桌子跟四張椅子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn sì zhāng yǐzi.
examples.english: I want to buy one table and four chairs.

examples.chinese: 我要買一張桌子跟四張椅子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn sì zhāng yǐzi.
examples.english: I want to buy one table and four chairs.

examples.chinese: 我跟媽媽明天下午要一起去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn māma míngtiān xiàwǔ yào yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Mom and I are going to see a movie tomorrow afternoon.

examples.chinese: 我跟同學常常一起在學校打網球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué chángcháng yìqǐ zài xuéxiào dǎ wǎngqiú.
examples.english: My classmates and I often play tennis together at the school.

examples.chinese: 我旁邊有日本同學，前面跟後面都有美國同學。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.
examples.english: There are Japanese classmates beside me, and there are American classmates in front and behind.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽有一個哥哥跟兩個妹妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma yǒu yí ge gēge gēn liǎng ge mèimei.
examples.english: My mom has an elder brother and two younger sisters.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn sì zhāng yǐzi.
examples.english: I want to buy one table and four chairs.

examples.chinese: 這個蛋糕跟這瓶果汁一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dàngāo gēn zhè píng guǒzhī yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do this cake and this bottle of juice cost?

examples.chinese: 知道，友美跟我講過。
examples.pinyin: Zhīdào, Yǒuměi gēn wǒ jiǎng guò.
examples.english: Yes, Youmei told me already.

examples.chinese: 這個星期六是元宵節，妳跟友美會去看燈會嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqī liù shì Yuánxiāojié, nǐ gēn Yǒuměi huì qù kàn dēnghuì ma?
examples.english: This Saturday is the Lantern Festival. Will you and Youmei go to see the Lantern Carnival?

examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

examples.chinese: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
examples.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

examples.chinese: 今天我要帶一些水果去看他，也會跟他說今天的功課。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yào dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn tā, yě huì gēn tā shuō jīntiān de gōngkè.
examples.english: Today, I am going to take some fruit to visit him and also inform him about the homework today.

examples.chinese: 國安跟我說，他今天要去看醫生，他家附近有一家不錯的醫院。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān gēn wǒ shuō, tā jīntiān yào qù kàn yīshēng, tā jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā búcuò de yīyuàn.
examples.english: Guoan told me he is going to see a doctor today; there is a nice hospital near his place.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 我們班只能禮拜一跟禮拜二下午用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zhǐ néng lǐbài yī gēn lǐbài èr xiàwǔ yòng.
examples.english: Our class can only use it in the afternoon on Mondays and Tuesdays.

examples.chinese: 好。我先回宿舍做功課，再跟你一起去找他。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ xiān huí sùshè zuò gōngkè, zài gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Okay. I will go back to the dormitory to do my homework first, then I will go to see him with you.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going to have afternoon tea now, but my wallet is not in the bedroom.

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 李導演因為拍那部電影而跟銀行借了不少錢。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi nà bù diànyǐng ér gēn yínháng jièle bùshǎo qián.
examples.english: Director Li, because he was filming that movie, borrowed quite a lot of money from the bank.

examples.chinese: 一般人都喜歡跟性格溫柔、樂觀的人交朋友。
examples.pinyin: Yībān rén dōu xǐhuān gēn xìnggé wēnróu, lèguān de rén jiāo péngyǒu.
examples.english: Most people like to make friends with people who have a gentle and optimistic personality.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Jiùjiu duì wǒ hěn hǎo, bùguǎn wǒ yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào gēn tā shuō yì shēng, tā yídìng huì bāngmáng.
examples.english: My uncle is very good to me; no matter what challenges I encounter, as long as I give him a mention, he will definitely help.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐今天穿了一件跟我相同牌子的洋裝，還好顏色不同。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě jīntiān chuān le yī jiàn gēn wǒ xiāngtóng páizi de yángzhuāng, hái hǎo yánsè bùtóng.
examples.english: Miss Chen wore a dress of the same brand as mine today; fortunately, the color is different.

examples.chinese: 小藍什麼都不怕，就是怕跟女生說話，只要一說話，他的臉就紅了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán shénme dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà gēn nǚshēng shuōhuà, zhǐyào yì shuōhuà, tā de liǎn jiù hóng le.
examples.english: Xiaolan is not afraid of anything; he is exactly afraid of talking to girls. As soon as he talks, his face turns red.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有自己的優點，不需要強調，也不必跟別人比來比去。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, bù xūyào qiángdiào, yě búbì gēn biérén bǐ lái bǐ qù.
examples.english: Everyone has their own strengths; there is no need to emphasize them, and no need to compare yourself with others back and forth.

examples.chinese: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.
examples.english: Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor.

examples.chinese: 對不起！我昨天跟你說話的態度不好，我向你道歉，請你別生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ zuótiān gēn nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù bù hǎo, wǒ xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn, qǐng nǐ bié shēngqì le.
examples.english: I'm sorry! My attitude when talking to you yesterday was not good. I apologize to you; please don't be angry anymore.

examples.chinese: 假日我常跟家人一塊兒去郊區爬山、野餐。
examples.pinyin: Jiàrì wǒ cháng gēn jiārén yīkuàir qù jiāoqū páshān, yěcān.
examples.english: On holidays, I often go hiking and picnicking in the suburbs together with my family.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: 我昨天親眼看到小史跟人吵架，才知道他罵人的樣子好可怕喔！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qīnyǎn kàndào Xiǎo Shǐ gēn rén chǎojià, cái zhīdào tā mà rén de yàngzi hǎo kěpà o!
examples.english: Yesterday I saw with my own eyes Xiao Shi arguing with someone, and only then did I realize how scary he looks when he scolds people!

examples.chinese: 有一些病人不肯乖乖吃藥，護理師得有耐心，慢慢地跟他們講道理。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē bìngrén bù kěn guāiguāi chī yào, hùlǐshī děi yǒu nàixīn, mànman de gēn tāmen jiǎng dàolǐ.
examples.english: Some patients refuse to take their medicine obediently, so nurses must have patience and slowly reason with them.

examples.chinese: 如果這個週末你沒有什麼打算，要不要跟我去看看臺灣規模最大的書店？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège zhōumò nǐ méiyǒu shénme dǎsuàn, yào bù yào gēn wǒ qù kànkan Táiwān guīmó zuì dà de shūdiàn?
examples.english: If you don't have any plans this weekend, do you want to go with me to see Taiwan's largest bookstore?

examples.chinese: 每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.
examples.english: Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我過得很充實，不但完成了期末報告，還跟同學去游泳、衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ guò de hěn chōngshí, búdàn wánchéng le qīmò bàogào, hái gēn tóngxué qù yóuyǒng, chōnglàng.
examples.english: This weekend I had a very full time—not only did I finish my final report, but I also went swimming and surfing with classmates.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 張先生的個性很活潑、說話很幽默，跟他聊天總是很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn huópō, shuōhuà hěn yōumò, gēn tā liáotiān zǒngshì hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's personality is very lively and his speech is very humorous; chatting with him is always very pleasant.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng qí zìxíngchē wánchéng huándǎo de xíngchéng, gēn nàixīn yǒuguān, gēn cōngmíng bù cōngmíng wúguān.
examples.english: Whether you can complete a round-the-island trip by bicycle is related to patience, and unrelated to whether you are smart or not.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo. Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english: Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags. On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 我今天跟同學穿了樣式不同，但是顏色相同的洋裝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān gēn tóngxué chuān le yàngshì bùtóng, dànshì yánsè xiāngtóng de yángzhuāng.
examples.english: Today my classmate and I wore dresses that are different in style but the same in color.

examples.chinese: 好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ ge rén dōu kàndào tā gēn zhè chǎng huǒzāi yǒuguān, tā búdàn bù chéngrèn, fǎn'ér shuō shì línjū zuò de.
examples.english: Several people saw that he was connected to this fire; not only did he not admit it, but instead he said the neighbor did it.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 我同學記筆記的速度很快，也記得很清楚，所以我常跟他借筆記來複習功課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué jì bǐjì de sùdù hěn kuài, yě jì de hěn qīngchu, suǒyǐ wǒ cháng gēn tā jiè bǐjì lái fùxí gōngkè.
examples.english: My classmate takes notes very quickly and also remembers them very clearly, so I often borrow his notes to review my lessons.

examples.chinese: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng rénmen shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn tígāo, kāishǐ zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí shí, xiūxián huódòng yě jiù gēnzhe duō le qǐlái.
examples.english: When people's standard of living rises and they begin to value quality of life, leisure activities then increase accordingly.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú sǐle zhēnde néng shàng tiāntáng, wǒ xiǎng rènhé rén dōu xīwàng nénggòu zài nàlǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: If after death one could truly go to heaven, I think anyone would hope to be able to be there together with the person they love most.

examples.chinese: 那個老闆做生意不老實，一再跟客人保證商品沒問題，其實是騙人的。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎobǎn zuò shēngyì bù lǎoshí, yīzài gēn kèrén bǎozhèng shāngpǐn méi wèntí, qíshí shì piànrén de.
examples.english: That boss is not honest in doing business; he repeatedly assures customers that the products have no problems, but actually it's a scam.

examples.chinese: 跟張先生聊天時，總是我問一句，他答一句，真沒意思。
examples.pinyin: Gēn Zhāng xiānsheng liáotiān shí, zǒngshì wǒ wèn yī jù, tā dá yī jù, zhēn méi yìsi.
examples.english: When chatting with Mr. Zhang, it's always I ask one sentence and he answers one sentence; it's really boring.

examples.chinese: 小李好幾次約女網友見面，都被拒絕，所以不再跟她聯絡了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ hǎojǐ cì yuē nǚ wǎngyǒu jiànmiàn, dōu bèi jùjué, suǒyǐ bù zài gēn tā liánluò le.
examples.english: Xiao Li asked his female online friend to meet several times but was rejected each time, so he no longer contacts her.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 小章已經結婚了，還常常跟其他女生約會，真是太花心了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng yǐjīng jiéhūn le, hái chángcháng gēn qítā nǚshēng yuēhuì, zhēn shì tài huāxīn le.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is already married, yet he often dates other girls; he is really too womanizing.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: 小簡今天遇到以前的女朋友，跟她喝了咖啡才回家，但不敢跟太太說實話。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn jīntiān yùdào yǐqián de nǚpéngyǒu, gēn tā hē le kāfēi cái huí jiā, dàn bù gǎn gēn tàitai shuō shíhuà.
examples.english: Today Xiao Jian ran into his ex-girlfriend, and only went home after having coffee with her, but he didn't dare tell his wife the truth.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin: 1. Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén. 2. A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english: 1. Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people. 2. A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu. Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together. Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì. 2. Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english: 1. This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance. 2. My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

examples.chinese: 國家跟國家之間的外交關係很重要，這方面的工作是總統負責的。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā gēn guójiā zhījiān de wàijiāo guānxì hěn zhòngyào, zhè fāngmiàn de gōngzuò shì zǒngtǒng fùzé de.
examples.english: Diplomatic relations between countries are very important; work in this area is the president's responsibility.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 大信覺得這個公司的薪水跟福利都不好，於是決定換工作。
examples.pinyin: Dàxìn juéde zhège gōngsī de xīnshuǐ gēn fúlì dōu bù hǎo, yúshì juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Daxin felt that this company's salary and benefits were both bad, so he decided to change jobs.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

items.wordHook: a 口(gate) says 止(stop) to the tough 艮(mountain) pressing on your 跟(heel).

examples.chinese: 每個人都有自己的優點，不需要強調，也不必跟別人比來比去。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, bù xūyào qiángdiào, yě búbì gēn biérén bǐ lái bǐ qù.
examples.english: Everyone has their own strengths; there is no need to emphasize them, and no need to compare yourself with others back and forth.

examples.chinese: 那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ shuāngyǔ xuéxiào qiángdiào, chúle Zhōngwén kè yǐwài, qítā de kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
examples.english: That bilingual school emphasizes that, except for Chinese classes, all other courses are taught in English.

examples.chinese: 有人說，生孩子容易，養小孩難，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, shēng háizi róngyì, yǎng xiǎohái nán, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: Some people say that giving birth to a child is easy, but raising a child is difficult. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy.

examples.chinese: 對不起！我昨天跟你說話的態度不好，我向你道歉，請你別生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ zuótiān gēn nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù bù hǎo, wǒ xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn, qǐng nǐ bié shēngqì le.
examples.english: I'm sorry! My attitude when talking to you yesterday was not good. I apologize to you; please don't be angry anymore.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 我哥哥開朗活潑、高大英俊，難怪有很多女生追求他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge kāilǎng huópō, gāodà yīngjùn, nánguài yǒu hěnduō nǚshēng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: My older brother is cheerful and lively, tall and handsome; no wonder many girls pursue him.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: 小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦。孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén hěn xiàoshùn, měi gè zhōumò dōu qù ānyǎngyuàn péi fùqīn liáotiān, sànbù, yīdiǎnr dōu bù juéde xīnkǔ. Xiàoshùn fùmǔ de fāngfǎ hěn duō, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bù ràng tāmen dānxīn, shēngqì.
examples.english: Xiao Chen is very filial; every weekend he goes to the nursing home to chat and take walks with his father, and doesn't feel the least bit tired. There are many ways to be filial to parents; the simplest is to not make them worry or get angry.

examples.chinese: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn de píxié, pídài, bùdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The leather shoes and belts that that factory produces are not only good in quality, but also not expensive in price.

examples.chinese: 這所大學有最新的電腦設備，提供學生很好的學習環境。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué yǒu zuìxīn de diànnǎo shèbèi, tígōng xuéshēng hěn hǎo de xuéxí huánjìng.
examples.english: This university has the latest computer equipment, providing students with a very good learning environment.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 超商常舉辦送小禮物或買一送一的活動，可是對王先生完全沒有吸引力。
examples.pinyin: Chāoshāng cháng jǔbàn sòng xiǎo lǐwù huò mǎi yī sòng yī de huódòng, kěshì duì Wáng xiānsheng wánquán méiyǒu xīyǐnlì.
examples.english: Convenience stores often hold promotions giving small gifts or buy-one-get-one-free, but they have completely no appeal to Mr. Wang.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: 小藍什麼都不怕，就是怕跟女生說話，只要一說話，他的臉就紅了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán shénme dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà gēn nǚshēng shuōhuà, zhǐyào yì shuōhuà, tā de liǎn jiù hóng le.
examples.english: Xiaolan is not afraid of anything; he is exactly afraid of talking to girls. As soon as he talks, his face turns red.

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 周先生買了一套用真皮做的沙發，坐起來很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu xiānsheng mǎi le yī tào yòng zhēnpí zuò de shāfā, zuò qǐlái hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Mr. Zhou bought a set of sofas made of genuine leather; they are very comfortable to sit on.

examples.chinese: 外國學生一開始學寫漢字的速度比較慢，只要多練習就能越寫越快了。
examples.pinyin: Wàiguó xuéshēng yī kāishǐ xué xiě Hànzì de sùdù bǐjiào màn, zhǐyào duō liànxí jiù néng yuè xiě yuè kuài le.
examples.english: Foreign students' speed at writing Chinese characters is relatively slow at first; as long as they practice more, they will be able to write faster and faster.

examples.chinese: 那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúwùshēng bù xiào de shíhou, yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, qíshí tā duì kèrén de tàidù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: When that waiter doesn't smile, he looks very fierce, but actually his attitude toward customers is very good.

examples.chinese: 那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì de shēngyì fēicháng hǎo, yīnwèi tāmen jìn le hěn duō tèbié de língshí, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xiǎng chángchang kàn.
examples.english: That supermarket's business is very good because they have stocked many special snacks; both adults and children want to taste them.

examples.chinese: 童先生穿著一件綠色的襯衫，配上一條咖啡色的褲子，看起來真像一棵樹。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xiānsheng chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de chènshān, pèi shàng yī tiáo kāfēisè de kùzi, kàn qǐlái zhēn xiàng yī kē shù.
examples.english: Mr. Tong is wearing a green shirt, matched with a brown pair of pants; he really looks like a tree.

examples.chinese: 謝先生是從很有名的學校畢業的，但是聽說因為吃不了苦，什麼工作都做得不久。
examples.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng shì cóng hěn yǒumíng de xuéxiào bìyè de, dànshì tīngshuō yīnwèi chī bùliǎo kǔ, shénme gōngzuò dōu zuò de bùjiǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Xie graduated from a very famous school, but I heard that because he can't endure hardship, he doesn't last long at any job.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 我室友的生活習慣很差，我已經忍耐他很久了，真希望他馬上搬走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shìyǒu de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn chà, wǒ yǐjīng rěnnài tā hěn jiǔ le, zhēn xīwàng tā mǎshàng bān zǒu.
examples.english: My roommate's living habits are very bad; I have tolerated him for a long time, and I really hope he moves out immediately.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 孔先生學法律，不但是為了當好律師，也是為了保護家人。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānsheng xué fǎlǜ, bùdàn shì wèile dāng hǎo lǜshī, yě shì wèile bǎohù jiārén.
examples.english: Mr. Kong studies law not only to become a good lawyer but also to protect his family.

examples.chinese: 黃先生這幾天一直發燒，腦子很不清楚，恐怕沒辦法寫劇本。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng zhè jǐ tiān yīzhí fāshāo, nǎozi hěn bù qīngchu, kǒngpà méi bànfǎ xiě jùběn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang has had a fever for the past few days, his brain is very unclear, and I'm afraid he won't be able to write the script.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 在外國跟在自己國家的生活一定不太一樣。
examples.pinyin: Zài wàiguó gēn zài zìjǐ guójiā de shēnghuó yídìng bú tài yíyàng.
examples.english: Living in a foreign country and living in your own country are definitely not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 我弟弟是小學四年級的學生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi shì xiǎoxué sì niánjí de xuéshēng.
examples.english: My younger brother is a fourth-grade elementary school student.

examples.chinese: 黑板上畫著一條河、一個湖，學生們還想畫一些山和房子。
examples.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng huàzhe yī tiáo hé, yī gè hú, xuéshēngmen hái xiǎng huà yīxiē shān hé fángzi.
examples.english: On the blackboard, a river and a lake are drawn; the students also want to draw some mountains and houses.

examples.chinese: 1997年出生的人屬什麼生肖？
examples.pinyin: Yī jiǔ jiǔ qī nián chūshēng de rén shǔ shénme shēngxiào?
examples.english: What zodiac sign do people born in 1997 belong to?

examples.chinese: 我是2005年七月在越南出生的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì èr líng líng wǔ nián qīyuè zài Yuènán chūshēng de.
examples.english: I was born in Vietnam in July 2005.

examples.chinese: 華人用十二生肖代表每一年。他常常代表學校去參加游泳比賽，所以在學校非常有名。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng shí'èr shēngxiào dàibiǎo měi yì nián. Tā chángcháng dàibiǎo xuéxiào qù cānjiā yóuyǒng bǐsài, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào fēicháng yǒumíng.
examples.english: Chinese people use the twelve zodiac signs to represent each year. He often represents the school to participate in swimming competitions, so he is very famous at school.

examples.chinese: 華人和日本人都有十二生肖，十二生肖的動物也一樣嗎？
examples.pinyin: Huárén hé Rìběnrén dōu yǒu shí'èr shēngxiào, shí'èr shēngxiào de dòngwù yě yíyàng ma?
examples.english: Chinese people and Japanese people both have the twelve zodiac signs; are the animals of the twelve zodiac signs also the same?

examples.chinese: 我們今天要學第十五課，老師會給我們介紹十二生肖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, lǎoshī huì gěi wǒmen jièshào shí'èr shēngxiào.
examples.english: Today we are going to study Lesson 15; the teacher will introduce the twelve zodiac signs to us.

examples.chinese: 明天是老師的生日，我們要送他一個大蛋糕，給他過生日。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì lǎoshī de shēngrì, wǒmen yào sòng tā yī gè dà dàngāo, gěi tā guò shēngrì.
examples.english: Tomorrow is the teacher's birthday, we will give him a big cake to celebrate his birthday.

examples.chinese: 我在台灣的生活不錯，很喜歡這裡，也有很多好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiwān de shēnghuó búcuò, hěn xǐhuan zhèlǐ, yě yǒu hěn duō hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: My life in Taiwan is good; I like it here a lot, and I also have many good friends.

examples.chinese: 學校的網站上有很多學生寫的文章。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de wǎngzhàn shàng yǒu hěn duō xuéshēng xiě de wénzhāng.
examples.english: On the school's website there are many articles written by students.

examples.chinese: 我生病了，媽媽今天要帶我去醫院看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēngbìng le, māma jīntiān yào dài wǒ qù yīyuàn kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: I got sick; my mom is going to take me to the hospital to see a doctor today.

examples.chinese: 李先生有三個孩子，一個兒子，兩個女兒。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng yǒu sān ge háizi, yí ge érzi, liǎng ge nǚ'ér.
examples.english: Mr. Li has three children: one son and two daughters.

examples.chinese: 今天是我的生日，媽媽準備了很多我愛吃的菜。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì, māma zhǔnbèi le hěn duō wǒ ài chī de cài.
examples.english: Today is my birthday; Mom prepared many dishes that I love to eat.

examples.chinese: A:我們要點幾盤菜？ B:今天是你的生日，我們多點幾盤吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào diǎn jǐ pán cài? B: Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, wǒmen duō diǎn jǐ pán ba.
examples.english: A: How many dishes shall we order? B: Today is your birthday; let's order a few more dishes.

examples.chinese: 他上個禮拜生病了，現在還在咳嗽。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng ge lǐbài shēngbìng le, xiànzài hái zài késou.
examples.english: He got sick last week, and he is still coughing now.

examples.chinese: 我常常在電視上看到那位有名的醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài diànshì shàng kàndào nà wèi yǒumíng de yīshēng.
examples.english: I often see that famous doctor on TV.

examples.chinese: 這是我朋友送我的生日卡片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou sòng wǒ de shēngrì kǎpiàn.
examples.english: This is the birthday card my friend gave me.

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 醫生說，我應該多喝水，不需要吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, bù xūyào chī yào.
examples.english: The doctor said I should drink more water and don't need to take medicine.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸很健康，不常生病。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba hěn jiànkāng, bù cháng shēngbìng.
examples.english: My dad is very healthy and doesn't often get sick.

examples.chinese: 他跟我說，他感冒了，要去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ shuō, tā gǎnmào le, yào qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He said to me that he caught a cold and needs to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 明天要考試，每個學生都很緊張。今天的考試不難，大家都考得不錯。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎoshì, měi ge xuésheng dōu hěn jǐnzhāng. Jīntiān de kǎoshì bù nán, dàjiā dōu kǎo de búcuò.
examples.english: There will be an exam tomorrow, so every student is very nervous. Today's exam was not difficult; everyone did pretty well on the test.

examples.chinese: 我們班有十個學生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yǒu shí ge xuésheng.
examples.english: Our class has ten students.

examples.chinese: 女生和男生都喜歡去百貨公司買東西。
examples.pinyin: Nǚshēng hé nánshēng dōu xǐhuān qù bǎihuò gōngsī mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: Both girls and boys like to go to the department store to shop.

examples.chinese: 明天是爸爸的生日，我要送他一個錶。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì bàba de shēngrì, wǒ yào sòng tā yī gè biǎo.
examples.english: Tomorrow is Dad's birthday; I want to give him a watch.

examples.chinese: 我昨天開始咳嗽，現在想去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān kāishǐ késòu, xiànzài xiǎng qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: I started to cough yesterday, and now I want to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend’s birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想要送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng yào sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend's birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 王老師的課很有趣，每個學生都喜歡她。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī de kè hěn yǒuqù, měi ge xuéshēng dōu xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: Teacher Wang’s class is very interesting; every student likes her.

examples.chinese: 那個學生很好看。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge xuéshēng hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: The student is very good-looking.

examples.chinese: 這朵花很好看。那個學生很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duǒ huā hěn hǎokàn. Nàge xuéshēng hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: This flower is very pretty. That student is very good-looking.

examples.chinese: 明天是媽媽的生日，你想送她什麼禮物？
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì māma de shēngrì, nǐ xiǎng sòng tā shénme lǐwù?
examples.english: Tomorrow is mom’s birthday, what do you want to give her as a gift?

examples.chinese: 老師：你們有問題嗎？ 學生：沒有。謝謝老師。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī: Nǐmen yǒu wèntí ma? Xuéshēng: Méi yǒu. Xièxie lǎoshī.
examples.english: Teacher: Do you have any questions? Student: No. Thank you, teacher.

examples.chinese: 老師：你們有問題嗎？學生：沒有。謝謝老師。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī: Nǐmen yǒu wèntí ma? Xuéshēng: Méi yǒu. Xièxie lǎoshī.
examples.english: Teacher: Do you have any questions? Student: No. Thank you, teacher.

examples.chinese: 啊！今天是你的生日。生日快樂！
examples.pinyin: Ā! Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì. Shēngrì kuàilè!
examples.english: Ah! It is your birthday today. Happy birthday!

examples.chinese: 這是我朋友做的，因為他屬虎。妳知道十二生肖嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou zuò de, yīnwèi tā shǔ hǔ. Nǐ zhīdào shí'èr shēngxiào ma?
examples.english: This is the lantern that my friend made because his Chinese zodiac animal sign is tiger. Do you know the Chinese animal zodiac?

examples.chinese: 原來是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì shí'èr shēngxiào, zhēnde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: Oh! You are talking about the Chinese animal zodiac! It’s really interesting.

examples.chinese: 什麼是十二生肖？
examples.pinyin: Shénme shì shí'èr shēngxiào?
examples.english: What is the Chinese animal zodiac?

examples.chinese: 越南也有十二生肖，可是我們沒有兔年，有貓年。我是貓年出生的，屬貓。
examples.pinyin: Yuènán yě yǒu shí'èr shēngxiào, kěshì wǒmen méi yǒu tù nián, yǒu māo nián. Wǒ shì māo nián chūshēng de, shǔ māo.
examples.english: There are also zodiac signs in Vietnam, but we don’t have the year of the Rabbit; we have the year of the Cat. I was born in the year of the Cat, which means my zodiac animal sign is cat.

examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 好，謝謝醫生。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, xièxie yīshēng.
examples.english: Okay, Thank you doctor.

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 國安跟我說，他今天要去看醫生，他家附近有一家不錯的醫院。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān gēn wǒ shuō, tā jīntiān yào qù kàn yīshēng, tā jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā búcuò de yīyuàn.
examples.english: Guoan told me he is going to see a doctor today; there is a nice hospital near his place.

examples.chinese: 老師，我很健康，不常生病。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ hěn jiànkāng, bù cháng shēngbìng.
examples.english: I am healthy and seldom get sick, teacher.

examples.chinese: 平常不生病的人也要注意。
examples.pinyin: Píngcháng bù shēngbìng de rén yě yào zhùyì.
examples.english: People who don’t get sick often should pay attention to their health as well.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 謝謝，這是我去年的生日禮物。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie, zhè shì wǒ qùnián de shēngrì lǐwù.
examples.english: Thanks, this is my birthday gift from last year.

examples.chinese: 明天是友美的生日，我想送她一個禮物。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì Yǒuměi de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge lǐwù.
examples.english: It is Youmei’s birthday tomorrow; I would like to give her a gift.

examples.chinese: 明天是九月二十三號……啊！是妳的生日！
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì jiǔ yuè èrshísān hào... Ā! Shì nǐ de shēngrì!
examples.english: It is September 23rd tomorrow...Ah! It is your birthday!

examples.chinese: 宜文，生日快樂！
examples.pinyin: Yíwén, shēngrì kuàilè!
examples.english: Happy birthday, Yiwen!

examples.chinese: 地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng. Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english: During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury. When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 這個社區的周圍有山有水，空氣也很好，這樣的生活環境很適合退休的人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèqū de zhōuwéi yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ, kōngqì yě hěn hǎo, zhèyàng de shēnghuó huánjìng hěn shìhé tuìxiū de rén.
examples.english: The neighborhood of this community has mountains and water, and the air is also very good; such a living environment is very suitable for retired people.

examples.chinese: 那位老先生走著走著，路旁的樹木突然倒了下來，他差一點就受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zǒuzhe zǒuzhe, lù páng de shùmù tūrán dǎo le xiàlái, tā chà yīdiǎn jiù shòushāng le.
examples.english: That elderly gentleman was walking and walking, when suddenly the trees beside the road fell down; he was almost injured.

examples.chinese: 孔先生很重視生活品質，也很喜歡做家事，所以總是把家裡整理得乾乾淨淨的。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānshēng hěn zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí, yě hěn xǐhuān zuò jiāshì, suǒyǐ zǒngshì bǎ jiālǐ zhěnglǐ de gāngānjìngjìng de.
examples.english: Mr. Kong values quality of life very much and also likes doing housework, so he always organizes his home until it is clean and tidy.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 今天是我女兒十歲的生日，我在蛋糕上點上十根蠟燭，一根代表一歲。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér shí suì de shēngrì, wǒ zài dàngāo shàng diǎn shàng shí gēn làzhú, yī gēn dàibiǎo yī suì.
examples.english: Today is my daughter's tenth birthday; I lit ten candles on the cake, each one representing one year of age.

examples.chinese: 陳老師為了引起學生的學習興趣，每次上課前都會準備一些有趣的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Chén lǎoshī wèile yǐnqǐ xuéshēng de xuéxí xìngqù, měi cì shàngkè qián dōu huì zhǔnbèi yīxiē yǒuqù de yóuxì.
examples.english: In order to arouse the students' interest in learning, Teacher Chen prepares some interesting games before every class.

examples.chinese: 醫生說你肩膀疼的原因，是因為長時間打電腦的關係。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nǐ jiānbǎng téng de yuányīn, shì yīnwèi cháng shíjiān dǎ diànnǎo de guānxì.
examples.english: The doctor said the reason your shoulder hurts is because of using the computer for a long time.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese: A:醫生，我求你快救救我的貓。 B:別急！我馬上檢查。
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng, wǒ qiú nǐ kuài jiùjiu wǒ de māo. B: Bié jí! Wǒ mǎshàng jiǎnchá.
examples.english: A: Doctor, I beg you to save my cat quickly. B: Don't worry! I'll examine it right away.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese: 歐先生有閱讀的障礙，就算一篇極短的文章，讀起來也覺得很困難。
examples.pinyin: Ōu xiānsheng yǒu yuèdú de zhàng'ài, jiùsuàn yī piān jí duǎn de wénzhāng, dú qǐlái yě juéde hěn kùnnán.
examples.english: Mr. Ou has a reading obstacle; even a very short article feels difficult for him to read.

examples.chinese: 太太：我今天很累，不想做飯。 先生：那就叫披薩好了。又快又不麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi, bù xiǎng zuòfàn. Xiānsheng: Nà jiù jiào pīsà hǎo le. Yòu kuài yòu bù máfan.
examples.english: Wife: I'm very tired today, I don't want to cook. Husband: Then let's just order pizza. It's quick and not troublesome.

examples.chinese: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
examples.english: When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

examples.chinese: 朋子看了好幾次醫生，吃了好幾個星期的藥，病總算好了。
examples.pinyin: Péngzǐ kàn le hǎo jǐ cì yīshēng, chī le hǎo jǐ gè xīngqī de yào, bìng zǒngsuàn hǎo le.
examples.english: Pengzi saw the doctor several times and took medicine for several weeks, and her illness finally got better.

examples.chinese: 公司的生產部門這個月規劃了員工旅遊，有三個不同地點讓大家選擇。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de shēngchǎn bùmén zhège yuè guīhuà le yuángōng lǚyóu, yǒu sān ge bùtóng dìdiǎn ràng dàjiā xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The company's production department planned an employee trip this month, with three different locations for everyone to choose from.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
